scope.source: three dedicated DSH real Flash runs plus their raw provider-bound, usage and RPC records
scope.publicPrivacyPolicy: whitelist only: no login account UID/name, credentials, raw tool cursors, signed URLs, session/request identifiers or private absolute directories

aggregate.usageAccounting: as reported by DSH provider usage; observed totalTokens equals inputTokens + outputTokens + cacheReadTokens + cacheWriteTokens; do not add totalTokens again
aggregate.costReason: No account invoice, applied tariffs, discounts, currency or cache billing contract in these records; token counts do not establish actual money charged.

systemPromptProjection.limit: does not imply all message history, tool schema or tool results are bounded by the persona snapshot budget

aggregate.runtimeCompactionLimit: policy installation is proven; these logs do not establish a triggered long-history summary or its long-term fidelity

limits: 264 total subtitle segments, only 50 actually returned in this source read; the final user-facing answer lists the requested first three
8 tool calls read JSON continuation fragments of one cached source result; they are not 8 separate videos or 8 model-independent platform fetches

chronology: Run 1: memory and unconfigured QQ scenarios observed; Bilibili scenario stopped at a deliberately bounded model budget after action mismatch.
Run 2: corrected API contract allowed Bilibili reads; model detected unrelated old-endpoint captions and honestly reported that limitation.
Client source fix: signed WBI player + media source binding; separate GET-only wire diagnostic retained outside this public summary.
Run 3: real Flash consumed the fixed signed subtitle result and reported the requested text, timestamps, bindings and incomplete coverage correctly.
measurementLimits: UTF-8 byte sizes and code-point sizes are serialized adapter input/output measures, not tokenizer estimates, external HTTP payload size or billing charges.
Per-request output cap 4096 is a response/summary cap, not a total input limit; actual local model metadata reports a 1000000-token context window.
Model response latency is not a direct measurement of private thinking time.
No universal guarantee about future provider subtitle correctness follows from one fixed real-video regression.
